messages:
alex: Quick sync: ops dry run for Gaudi & MI300 marketplace launch next Wed. Want to run a full embargo simulation + SKU handoff. Who can join?

maria: I'm in. Can Security review embargo timing? We need final KMS certs.

cheng: Will run compatibility tests on staging. ETA results by Tue EOD.

vendor-nathan: Partner FYI — H200 availability still TBD for that wave; procurement update Monday.

pr: :wave: we'll need embargo windows from Partnerships by EOD today.

ops-bot: Reminder: dry-run scheduled for 2026-03-25 09:00 PT — RSVP if you haven't.

alex: Added runbook draft in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/.../dryrun-gaudi-mi300. Plan:
1) infra surge
2) migrate marketplace SKUs
3) press embargo handshake
4) SI enablement checklist

maria: Link? can't access.

alex: Oops — permissions updated. Try now.

sandra: SI readiness: need final images from infra (kernel + driver). Can we lock by Mon 12:00 PT?

cheng: Driver build queued. If tests pass, I'll publish images by Mon 10:00 PT.

vendor-nathan: Gaudi vendor note: firmware v2.14 required for KV cache perf. Will push to staging cluster.

pr: We should rehearse statements — I'll draft two variants: technical release & partner co-announce.

alex: Rehearse plan: dry-run + tabletop 45m. Please add any showstopper scenarios to thread.

sandra: Showstopper: SI can't access private repo for onboarding scripts — blocked on SCIM.

maria: Security: SCIM token will be provisioned by infra; request submitted.

cheng: :thumbsup: adding health-check scripts to the repo.

ops-bot: RSVPs: alex, maria, cheng, sandra, vendor-nathan, pr. Missing: marketplace-engineering, legal.

alex: Legal — @sara_legal can you confirm NDA wording for partner quotes?

sara_legal: I can join quick review Mon 11:00 PT. NDA looks fine; recommend minor wording change to para 3.

alex: Noted. Final item: can we simulate consumer traffic (prefix caching hit-rate) in dry-run? Cheng?

cheng: Yes — will run load test with 200 rps for 10m during dry-run. I'll publish results to the runbook.

vendor-nathan: FYI: B200 spots available for Dedicated customers — will send SKU matrix to partnerships.

pr: Thanks. I'll slot the press rehearsal Tue 16:00 PT.

alex: :thumbsup: Thanks team — adding follow-ups to the runbook. If anything else, drop here.
